title: Netlify Server
lede: Netlify Server adds a long-running backend to Netlify projects, so apps can keep WebSocket connections and in-memory state alive instead of squeezing into short-lived functions.

points: Holds WebSockets open and keeps caches, connection pools and other state in memory across requests.
Runs existing Express, Fastify, Hono or Koa apps without adapters, or an agent in the Netlify UI builds the backend from a description.
Agent loops and long model calls can run for minutes or hours without being cut off by a function timeout.
Deploys with the frontend: every deploy preview gets its own server, and each branch gets its own Netlify Database branch.
Scales up with traffic and back down to zero when nothing is using it.

sections.text: Teams on Netlify building multiplayer games, live chat, collaborative tools or long-running AI agents, who previously had to host that part of the app elsewhere.
Usage is free during early access. The launch does not say what it will cost afterwards.
